_comment: skillopt-night backend chain (bin/failover.py), operator-approved order 2026-10-12. Every entry is answered through acp-run (one fresh process per prompt) after its preflight: aiuse pool usable_now with headroom above floor_percent, or the SIPB proxy health URL, or (crush) a one-prompt probe. Allowed TUIs: opencode, agy, zcode, claude (Haiku/Sonnet), crush, sipb (direct OpenAI-compatible POST to the loopback proxy, no agent; operator 2026-10-13: direct first, crush ACP as its failover). Denied words: cursor, cline, clinepass, hermes, opus, fable, muse, pi, grok, codex, copilot. claude takes the acp-run model values haiku/sonnet (Haiku 5.5/Sonnet 5.5; --native passes claude-haiku-5-5/claude-sonnet-5-5). Round 1 sends one mining prompt per harvested session; max_sessions caps it. deadline: local HH:MM the whole night must end by. exclude_projects: path prefixes whose sessions never leave the machine (every source). Optional (2026-10-13): top-level prompt_max_load (1-min load per core above which a prompt waits before spawning; default 2.0) and prompt_load_wait_s (give up and count a startup failure after this many seconds; default 600); per-entry retry_budget (startup failures retried per round, default max(3, 25% of the prompts)); sipb entries are a direct POST to the loopback proxy (no agent), crush stays last and is refused while its canary fails.
